import Mathlib

-- Precondition definition
@[reducible, simp]
def can_jump_precond (nums : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  0 < nums.length ∧
  nums.length ≤ 10000 ∧
  (∀ i, i < nums.length → nums.getD i 0 ≤ 10000)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_valid_jump_path (path : List Nat) (nums : List Nat) : Prop :=
  path.length > 0 ∧
  path.head? = some 0 ∧
  path.getLast? = some (nums.length - 1) ∧
  (∀ i, i < path.length → path.getD i 0 < nums.length) ∧
  (∀ i, i < path.length - 1 →
    let u := path.getD i 0
    let v := path.getD (i+1) 0
    u < v ∧ v ≤ u + nums.getD u 0)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def decidable_forall_nat_lt
    (n : Nat) (p : Nat → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Decidable (∀ i, i < n → p i) := by
  apply decidable_of_iff (∀ i : Fin n, p i)
  constructor
  · intro h i hi
    exact h ⟨i, hi⟩
  · intro h i
    exact h i.val i.isLt

instance instDecidableIsValidJumpPath
    (path nums : List Nat) : Decidable (is_valid_jump_path path nums) := by
  unfold is_valid_jump_path
  letI : Decidable
      (∀ i, i < path.length → path.getD i 0 < nums.length) :=
    decidable_forall_nat_lt path.length
      (fun i => path.getD i 0 < nums.length)
  letI : Decidable
      (∀ i, i < path.length - 1 →
        let u := path.getD i 0
        let v := path.getD (i + 1) 0
        u < v ∧ v ≤ u + nums.getD u 0) :=
    decidable_forall_nat_lt (path.length - 1)
      (fun i =>
        let u := path.getD i 0
        let v := path.getD (i + 1) 0
        u < v ∧ v ≤ u + nums.getD u 0)
  infer_instance

def decidable_exists_fintype
    (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Decidable (∃ x : α, p x) := by
  apply decidable_of_iff
    (∃ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α), p x)
  simp

def finite_jump_path_exists (nums : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ k : Fin (nums.length + 1),
    ∃ f : Fin k.val → Fin nums.length,
      is_valid_jump_path (List.ofFn (fun i => (f i).val)) nums

instance instDecidableFiniteJumpPathExists
    (nums : List Nat) : Decidable (finite_jump_path_exists nums) := by
  unfold finite_jump_path_exists
  letI : DecidablePred
      (fun k : Fin (nums.length + 1) =>
        ∃ f : Fin k.val → Fin nums.length,
          is_valid_jump_path
            (List.ofFn (fun i => (f i).val)) nums) :=
    fun k =>
      decidable_exists_fintype
        (Fin k.val → Fin nums.length)
        (fun f =>
          is_valid_jump_path
            (List.ofFn (fun i => (f i).val)) nums)
  exact
    decidable_exists_fintype
      (Fin (nums.length + 1))
      (fun k =>
        ∃ f : Fin k.val → Fin nums.length,
          is_valid_jump_path
            (List.ofFn (fun i => (f i).val)) nums)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def can_jump (nums : List Nat) (h_precond : can_jump_precond nums) : Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  decide (finite_jump_path_exists nums)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definition
@[reducible, simp]
def can_jump_postcond (nums : List Nat) (result : Bool) (h_precond : can_jump_precond nums) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (result = true) ↔ ∃ (path : List Nat), is_valid_jump_path path nums
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma list_getD_eq_get_of_lt
    {α : Type} (l : List α) (i : Nat) (fallback : α)
    (hi : i < l.length) :
    l.getD i fallback = l.get ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
  simp [List.getD, hi]

lemma valid_jump_path_length_le
    {path nums : List Nat}
    (hpath : is_valid_jump_path path nums) :
    path.length ≤ nums.length := by
  rcases hpath with
    ⟨hlen, _hhead, _hlast, hbounded, hjumps⟩
  have hindex :
      ∀ i, i < path.length → i ≤ path.getD i 0 := by
    intro i hi
    induction i with
    | zero =>
        omega
    | succ i ih =>
        have hiPrev : i < path.length - 1 := by
          omega
        have hstep := hjumps i hiPrev
        dsimp at hstep
        have hiPath : i < path.length := by
          omega
        have hih := ih hiPath
        omega
  have hlastIndex :
      path.length - 1 ≤ path.getD (path.length - 1) 0 :=
    hindex (path.length - 1) (by omega)
  have hlastBound :
      path.getD (path.length - 1) 0 < nums.length :=
    hbounded (path.length - 1) (by omega)
  omega

lemma finite_jump_path_exists_iff (nums : List Nat) :
    finite_jump_path_exists nums ↔
      ∃ path : List Nat, is_valid_jump_path path nums := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, f, hvalid⟩
    exact ⟨List.ofFn (fun i => (f i).val), hvalid⟩
  · rintro ⟨path, hvalid⟩
    have hlen : path.length ≤ nums.length :=
      valid_jump_path_length_le hvalid
    have hbounded :
        ∀ i, i < path.length → path.getD i 0 < nums.length :=
      hvalid.2.2.2.1
    let k : Fin (nums.length + 1) :=
      ⟨path.length, by omega⟩
    let f : Fin k.val → Fin nums.length :=
      fun i =>
        let hi : i.val < path.length := by
          simpa [k] using i.isLt
        ⟨path.get ⟨i.val, hi⟩, by
          rw [← list_getD_eq_get_of_lt path i.val 0 hi]
          exact hbounded i.val hi⟩
    refine ⟨k, f, ?_⟩
    have hof :
        List.ofFn (fun i => (f i).val) = path := by
      simpa [f, k] using List.ofFn_get path
    rw [hof]
    exact hvalid
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem can_jump_postcond_satisfied (nums : List Nat) (h_precond : can_jump_precond nums) :
    can_jump_postcond nums (can_jump nums h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  change
    (decide (finite_jump_path_exists nums) = true) ↔
      ∃ path : List Nat, is_valid_jump_path path nums
  rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
  exact finite_jump_path_exists_iff nums
  -- !benchmark @end proof
